entries.049f61471aa485f0: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥366,060 million. entries.2a77f027dad381d7: As its group vision, it states: “Aiming for the optimal distribution of food, we will create a ‘Distribution Forest’ and, as the most trusted community-based wholesale group, contribute to the development of our business partners and society.” It has launched its second long-term strategy covering the period from the fiscal year ending December 2026 to the fiscal year ending December 2030 and, under its long-term vision “Changing ‘Wholesale’” toward 2030, aims to shift to a more profitable business model through initiatives in new growth areas.

Sales to FamilyMart Co., Ltd., its major customer, were ¥42,162 million in the fiscal year ended December 2025, or 11.5% of consolidated revenue.
entries.37c28f53edb11a68: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,448 million. Higher revenue and various improvement activities, including restraint of logistics costs, led to higher profit.

entries.60aeaf9e7235ceec: It generates revenue from sales of products and goods. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥366,060 million, up from ¥348,074 million in the previous fiscal year. Strong transactions across each sales channel led to higher revenue.
entries.910e725e581a28f3: In addition to purchasing and selling processed foods, alcoholic beverages, chilled and frozen foods, and others, it also manufactures prepared foods. It operates low-temperature, constant-temperature and ambient-temperature distribution centers, mainly in the Tokai region, and handles sales and logistics in an integrated manner.
entries.b19ad6656ea05d48: This is a wholesale business handling food, liquor and other products. The group consists of a single segment, the food and liquor wholesale business and its ancillary businesses, and is composed of six subsidiaries and one affiliate. The consolidated subsidiaries are three companies: Tokan Co., Ltd., which engages in wholesale and processing of mainly food products; Kokubu Chubu Co., Ltd., which wholesales liquor and food; and Sankyu Co., Ltd., which wholesales food for institutional catering. It supplies products to sales channels such as supermarkets, restaurants, takeout and catering operators, convenience stores and drugstores, and operates chilled, temperature-controlled and ambient-temperature distribution centers mainly in the Tokai region. Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥366,060 million.

Consolidated employees number 798.
entries.e0ca7611ff4fab40: It states that it is advancing its efforts on both sales strategies and logistics strategies. For supermarkets, it designates the Aichi Mikawa, Shizuoka and Mie areas as priority regions and is strengthening product development and proposals based on each region’s customer needs and changes in consumer preferences, as well as proposals to prepared-food departments. For drugstores, it is working with customers to improve profitability and expanding the logistics areas that the group handles on contract.
